desc: LogicalDOC Community Edition through 9.3 contains an HQL injection vulnerability in DocumentsDataServlet that allows authenticated users to manipulate queries via the unvalidated indexed parameter. Attackers with read access to any folder can inject boolean HQL expressions to bypass folder scope and read-permission checks, listing restricted document metadata and extracting database contents.

title: yshop-crm through 2.1.3 Missing Authorization via invoice check endpoint
desc: yshop-crm through 2.1.3 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows any authenticated back-office user to approve or reject invoices via POST /admin-api/crm/invoice/check. The CrmInvoiceController check handler lacks @PreAuthorize and approver checks are commented out, letting attackers bypass the invoice approval workflow by supplying any invoice id.

title: MoguBlog through 6.2 Credential Disclosure via /oauth/getSystemConfig
desc: MoguBlog through 6.2 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows low-privileged front-end users to read system credentials via the getSystemConfig endpoint. Attackers can supply an ordinary reader session token to retrieve unfiltered SystemConfig data, exposing Qiniu and MinIO secret keys and SMTP mailbox passwords.

title: MoguBlog through 6.2 Broken Access Control via /networkDisk/getFileList
desc: MoguBlog through 6.2 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated administrators to list other administrators' network-disk files via POST /networkDisk/getFileList. Attackers can query the endpoint, which filters only by status, file type, or filePath and never by admin_uid, to obtain other administrators' file names and download URLs.

title: jshERP through 3.6 Missing Authorization via /log Audit Endpoints
desc: jshERP through 3.6 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in LogController that allows any authenticated user to forge, modify, or delete audit log entries. Low-privilege users can call /log/add, /log/update, /log/delete, and /log/deleteBatch to fabricate entries, rewrite user and IP fields, or erase records to hide activity.

title: jshERP through 3.6 Missing Authorization via /log/list and /log/info
desc: jshERP through 3.6 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in LogController that allows any authenticated user to read the tenant's operation audit log. Low-privilege users can send GET requests to /log/list or /log/info to view other users' login names, client IP addresses, and actions.

title: jshERP through 3.6 Authorization Bypass via User-Controlled Warehouse IDs
desc: jshERP through 3.6 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to read data from unassigned warehouses by supplying depotId or depotIds request parameters. When depot_flag warehouse restriction is enabled, attackers can name arbitrary warehouse ids in endpoints like /depotItem/getMaterialDepotStockByParam to read stock levels, batch numbers, sales figures and pri

title: jshERP through 3.6 Approval Bypass via addDepotHeadAndDetail Status Parameter
desc: jshERP through 3.6 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to create pre-approved bills by setting status in POST /depotHead/addDepotHeadAndDetail requests. Attackers can supply a status of 1 to skip audit permission checks and multi-level approval workflows, creating audited bills that affect stock and report queries.

title: jshERP through 3.6 Data Scope Bypass via /account/findAccountInOutList
desc: jshERP through 3.6 contains an improper authorization vulnerability that allows low-privilege authenticated users to read any settlement account ledger by supplying an arbitrary accountId. Attackers restricted to personal or department data scope can query GET /account/findAccountInOutList to view other users' bill numbers, counterparties, amounts and remarks within the tenant.

title: jshERP through 3.6 Privilege Escalation via PUT /user/updateUser
desc: jshERP through 3.6 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the UserController updateUser handler that allows authenticated users to assign arbitrary roles to any user. Low-privilege attackers can send their own user id with the tenant administrator roleId to escalate privileges or rebind other tenant users' roles.

title: jshERP through 3.6 Missing Authorization in Master Data Add and Import Endpoints
desc: jshERP through 3.6 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows low-privilege authenticated users to create tenant-wide master data via add and import endpoints lacking role checks. Attackers can send POST requests to endpoints like /account/add, /material/add, or /material/importExcel to create settlement accounts, products with initial stock, departments and dictionary entries.

title: Quay: build trigger uuid idor in quay api
desc: A flaw was found in Red Hat Quay. The build trigger management application programming interface (API) fails to verify whether a requested trigger belongs to the specified repository. An authenticated user with administrative access to any repository can view, modify, or permanently delete build triggers and associated write tokens of another repository if they know the victim trigger's universall

title: LogicalDOC Community Edition through 9.3 Missing Authorization in DocumentService
desc: LogicalDOC Community Edition through 9.3 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in SoapDocumentService operations that allows authenticated users to access and modify unauthorized documents. Attackers can call copy, getExtractedText, deleteVersion, reindex, deleteLink, or restore via SOAP or /services/rest/document with sequential document IDs to disclose, delete, or tamper with documents.

title: LogicalDOC Community Edition through 9.3 Missing Authorization via zip-export Servlet
desc: LogicalDOC Community Edition through 9.3 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the zip-export servlet that allows authenticated users to export restricted folders by supplying a folderId parameter. Attackers can request /zip-export with a restricted folder ID, since ZipExport.addFolderDocuments() skips READ and DOWNLOAD permission checks, to download all of its documents in a ZIP archi

title: LogicalDOC Community Edition through 9.3 Missing Authorization via ConvertPdf Servlet
desc: LogicalDOC Community Edition through 9.3 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the ConvertPdf servlet that allows authenticated users to download restricted PDF documents. Attackers can enumerate sequential docId values and use the version parameter to retrieve any PDF and its versions from folders they cannot access.

title: LogicalDOC Community Edition through 9.3 Username Enumeration via AvatarServlet
desc: LogicalDOC Community Edition through 9.3 contains a username enumeration vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to identify valid accounts because the AvatarServlet (/avatar) performs no session validation. Attackers can supply usernames or numeric IDs in the userId parameter and compare 1x1 transparent images against real avatars to enumerate users and retrieve profile pictures.

title: SGLang through 0.5.21 Memory Exhaustion DoS via /v1/audio/transcriptions Upload
desc: SGLang through 0.5.21 contains an unbounded memory allocation vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to exhaust memory by uploading oversized files to /v1/audio/transcriptions. Attackers can send concurrent large multipart uploads, which are fully read into memory before validation, to crash the HTTP/tokenizer worker and deny service.

title: SGLang through 0.5.21 Audio Decompression Amplification via load_audio
desc: SGLang through 0.5.21 contains a decompression amplification vulnerability in load_audio that allows remote attackers to exhaust memory by submitting highly compressed audio decoded without duration or sample limits. Attackers can supply small FLAC-encoded silence files through audio_url or audio_data inputs that expand into massive PCM buffers, exhausting worker memory and CPU for denial of servi

title: SGLang through 0.5.21 Decompression Bomb DoS via NanoNemotronVLImageProcessor
desc: SGLang through 0.5.21 contains a denial of service vulnerability that disables Pillow decompression bomb protection process-wide by setting Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS to None in NanoNemotronVLImageProcessor. Remote attackers can submit small, highly compressed images with huge dimensions to the generic image loader, exhausting worker memory during decoding.

title: Crawl4AI 0.7.0 before 0.9.4 SSRF via link_preview_config URL Seeder
desc: Crawl4AI 0.7.0 before 0.9.4 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows API clients to reach internal addresses by enabling link_preview_config on /crawl requests. Attackers can supply a controlled page with include_external and include_patterns set, causing AsyncUrlSeeder to fetch internal, private, and cloud-metadata links and return their parsed head data.

title: Crawl4AI before 0.9.4 Blind SSRF via RobotsParser.can_fetch robots.txt Fetch
desc: Crawl4AI before 0.9.4 contains a blind server-side request forgery vulnerability in RobotsParser.can_fetch that lets unauthenticated attackers bypass Docker server egress controls. Attackers can enable check_robots_txt and use redirects or DNS rebinding to reach internal, loopback, or cloud-metadata addresses for service discovery.

title: FreeRDP 3.11.0 before 3.32.1 Reachable Assertion DoS via urb_isoch_transfer
desc: FreeRDP 3.11.0 before 3.32.1 contains a reachable assertion vulnerability in urb_isoch_transfer that allows malicious RDP servers to crash clients by sending unvalidated OutputBufferSize values. Attackers can send a TS_URB_ISOCH_TRANSFER IN-direction request with OutputBufferSize above INT32_MAX over URBDRC, triggering an assertion in libusb_udev_isoch_transfer that terminates the client.

title: FreeRDP 3.0.0 before 3.32.0 Insecure Permissions on Soft-Smartcard Private Key File
desc: FreeRDP from 3.0.0 before 3.32.0 contains an incorrect permission assignment vulnerability that allows local users to read private keys written by crypto_write_pem without owner-only permissions. Attackers on multi-user Unix hosts can enumerate the shared temporary directory during soft-smartcard logon to read the world-readable PKINIT private-key copy.

title: FreeRDP 2.0.0 before 3.32.0 Insecure Private Key Permissions in winpr-makecert
desc: FreeRDP from 2.0.0 before 3.32.0 contains an insecure permission vulnerability in winpr-makecert that creates unencrypted private keys without owner-only file modes. Local users on multi-user Unix hosts can read world-readable key files or open PFX files protected by the hard-coded default password to steal private keys.

title: FreeRDP 3.0.0 before 3.32.0 Improper Certificate Validation in freerdp_http_request
desc: FreeRDP 3.0.0 before 3.32.0 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability in freerdp_http_request() in libfreerdp/utils/http.c that completes TLS handshakes without verifying the server certificate chain. On-path attackers can impersonate login.microsoftonline.com in the Azure AD authentication flow to capture OAuth authorization codes and substitute the OpenID discovery document.

title: FreeRDP 3.0.0 before 3.32.0 Heap Out-of-Bounds Read via WinPR Clipboard cFileName
desc: FreeRDP 3.0.0 before 3.32.0 contains a heap out-of-bounds read in the WinPR clipboard function convert_filedescriptors_to_file_list(), which scans a server-controlled FILEDESCRIPTORW cFileName with unbounded _wcschr() and count_special_chars() calls without a NUL-termination guarantee. A malicious RDP server can send an odd-length FILEDESCRIPTORW blob in a CB_FORMAT_DATA_RESPONSE, crashing X11, Wa

title: FreeRDP 3.0.0 before 3.32.0 Heap Out-of-Bounds Read via Remote Assistance File Parsing
desc: FreeRDP 3.0.0 before 3.32.0 contains a heap out-of-bounds read in freerdp_assistance_parse_all_elements_of() because it advances its parsing cursor without reducing the remaining length, letting the scan window exceed the decrypted ConnectionString2 buffer. Attackers can supply a crafted .msrcIncident invitation file and password that crash xfreerdp when opened, before any RDP connection.

title: FreeRDP 3.0.0 before 3.32.0 Heap Buffer Overflow via PKCS#11 collect_keys()
desc: FreeRDP 3.0.0 before 3.32.0 contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in collect_keys() that allows local attackers to write past the fixed 64-entry keys array during PKCS#11 key enumeration. Attackers controlling smartcard tokens can present more than 64 public key objects across multiple slots to corrupt heap memory with attacker-chosen CKA_ID and CKA_LABEL data during smartcard logon.

title: FreeRDP 3.9.0 before 3.32.0 RDPEAR NDR Scalar Out-of-Bounds Read
desc: FreeRDP from 3.9.0 before 3.32.0 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the RDPEAR NDR scalar readers, which check value length before consuming alignment padding. Malicious or compromised RDP servers can send crafted unaligned RDPEAR payloads, such as CreateApReqAuthenticatorReq messages, to clients using Remote Credential Guard, causing over-reads and potentially crashing the client pro

title: FreeRDP 2.1.0 before 3.32.0 Use-After-Free via rdpsnd Disconnect Path
desc: FreeRDP 2.1.0 before 3.32.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the static rdpsnd channel disconnect path, which frees audio formats and device without joining play_thread. A malicious RDP server can disconnect while asynchronous Wave2 playback processes queued PDUs, causing the client to read freed heap memory and crash.

title: FreeRDP 3.0.0 before 3.32.0 heap buffer overflow via license_check_stream_length
desc: FreeRDP 3.0.0 before 3.32.0 contains an integer truncation vulnerability in license_check_stream_length that allows a malicious RDP server to trigger a heap buffer overflow on 32-bit clients. Attackers can send a crafted SERVER_LICENSE_REQUEST with a large scopeCount that bypasses length checks, causing out-of-bounds writes leading to denial of service or remote code execution.

title: ImageMagick 7.1.0-20 before 7.1.2-32 Invalid Memory Free in FX Operation
desc: ImageMagick 7.1.0-20 before 7.1.2-32 contains an invalid memory free vulnerability in the fx operation that occurs when initialization of an FX runtime entry fails. Attackers can trigger the failed FX runtime initialization to cause an invalid free, resulting in memory corruption and application crashes.

title: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 Information Disclosure in TGA Decoder
desc: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains an uninitialized memory read in the TGA image decoder that can expose memory contents. Attackers can supply a crafted TGA image for processing to disclose contents of uninitialized memory from the ImageMagick process.

title: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 Memory Leak in PNG Encoder
desc: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains a memory leak in the PNG encoder, which does not release allocated memory when libpng initialization fails. Attackers who can repeatedly trigger PNG encoding operations in which libpng initialization fails can exhaust memory and cause a denial of service.

title: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 Memory Leak in YUV Encoder
desc: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains a memory leak in the YUV encoder, which fails to release allocated memory when a specific operation fails. Attackers can supply crafted input that triggers the failing encoder operation, leaking memory and potentially exhausting resources to cause a denial of service.

title: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 Stack Overflow in MVG Decoder
desc: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains uncontrolled recursion in the MVG decoder that can exhaust the program stack. An attacker who controls a file name processed by ImageMagick can trigger a stack overflow that crashes the process, causing a denial of service.

title: ImageMagick 7.1.1-7 before 7.1.2-32 Heap Buffer Over-Read via XMP Profile
desc: ImageMagick 7.1.1-7 before 7.1.2-32 contains a heap buffer over-read vulnerability that allows attackers to read beyond allocated memory due to incorrect string termination in XMP profiles. Attackers can supply a crafted image containing a malformed XMP profile to trigger the over-read and crash the application.

title: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 Use After Free in PDF Writer via JPEG2000
desc: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains a use after free vulnerability in the PDF writer when writing CMYK images with JPEG2000 compression. Attackers can supply a crafted CMYK image that, when written to PDF with JPEG2000 compression, causes freed memory to be reused, potentially crashing the process.

title: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 Information Disclosure via JPEG Decoder
desc: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in the JPEG decoder, which performs a read that exposes uninitialized memory when handling crafted input. Attackers can supply a crafted JPEG file for processing to disclose uninitialized memory contents.

title: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-32 Memory Leak via -process Option
desc: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-32 contains a memory leak vulnerability in the -process option that allows attackers to cause unreleased memory allocations by supplying certain arguments. Attackers can repeatedly invoke the -process option with crafted arguments to gradually exhaust memory and degrade service availability.

title: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 Information Disclosure in PostScript Decoder
desc: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in the PostScript decoder, which allocates a buffer one byte longer than the data it decoded. Attackers can supply a crafted PostScript file to expose a single uninitialized byte of memory contents.

title: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-32 TOCTOU Symlink Race Path Policy Bypass via magick script
desc: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-32 contains a time-of-check time-of-use symlink race vulnerability that allows attackers to bypass the path security policy when executing a magick script. Attackers can swap a checked path with a symlink during script execution to read files that the security policy is meant to block.

title: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 Code Injection via MVG Decoder
desc: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains a code injection vulnerability in the MVG decoder when a PostScript renderer is used. Attackers can supply a crafted MVG file that, when decoded, injects code into the PostScript rendering path.

title: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 Memory Leak in Wavelet-Denoise Operation
desc: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains a memory leak in the wavelet-denoise operation, which fails to release allocated memory when a required resource cannot be acquired. Attackers can repeatedly trigger wavelet-denoise processing under resource-constrained conditions to leak memory and degrade service availability.

title: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 Heap Buffer Overflow via Concurrent Security Policy Access
desc: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 lacks proper synchronization when the security policy is accessed, so simultaneous reads and writes of the policy by multiple threads trigger a race condition that causes a heap buffer over-write. An attacker able to induce concurrent security policy access can crash the application, causing a denial of service.

title: ImageMagick 7.1.0-20 before 7.1.2-32 Use After Free via -fx Option
desc: ImageMagick 7.1.0-20 before 7.1.2-32 contains a use after free vulnerability in the -fx option that occurs when a memory allocation fails during a specific operation. Attackers who can supply crafted -fx expressions under memory pressure can trigger freed memory access, causing crashes or memory corruption.

title: Open WebUI 0.11.1 before 0.11.4 Authorization Bypass via OAuth Token Exchange
desc: Open WebUI from 0.11.1 before 0.11.4 contains an authorization bypass in the OAuth token exchange endpoint, which reads role claims only from the provider's userinfo response and keeps the user's existing role when no roles claim is found, ignoring roles sent only in the ID token. Users with a linked account whose identity provider role no longer satisfies the OAuth role policy can send a valid pr

title: Open WebUI 0.11.0 before 0.11.4 Improper Authorization via Chat Fork Endpoint
desc: Open WebUI from 0.11.0 before 0.11.4 contains an improper authorization vulnerability in the chat fork handler, which places forked chats in the source chat's folder without checking folder write access. Shared folder members downgraded to read-only can call POST /api/v1/chats/{id}/fork on chats they created there while they had write access, inserting attacker-controlled chats visible to the fold

title: Open WebUI 0.6.0 before 0.11.4 Improper Access Control via Stale File Metadata
desc: Open WebUI from 0.6.0 before 0.11.4 contains an improper access control vulnerability in has_access_to_file that lets former knowledge base collaborators keep file access via stale cached knowledge base references. Attackers with read or write grants can download removed files through the file content endpoint or delete them, including from the owner's private knowledge bases.

title: Open WebUI before 0.11.4 Stored XSS via javascript: URLs in Markdown Links
desc: Open WebUI before 0.11.4 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in MarkdownInlineTokens.svelte, which renders markdown link URLs into anchor hrefs without validating their scheme. Authenticated users can embed javascript: links in shared chats that, when clicked by a victim, steal the victim's JWT from local storage, including admins' tokens.

title: Open WebUI 0.8.8 before 0.11.4 Improper Session Revocation via Terminal WebSocket
desc: Open WebUI from 0.8.8 before 0.11.4 contains an improper authorization vulnerability that allows deactivated users to keep executing terminal commands through an already open terminal WebSocket. Because the terminal proxy route in terminals.py checks access only on the first message, deactivated users can keep running commands and reading or writing files on the terminal server.

title: Open WebUI 0.11.1 before 0.11.4 Stored XSS via DOCX Preview
desc: Open WebUI from 0.11.1 before 0.11.4 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in DocxPreview.svelte that allows authenticated users to execute script by uploading crafted DOCX attachments. Attackers can embed an OOXML altChunk HTML part or script-scheme hyperlink to steal a previewing administrator's session token from local storage and take over the instance.

title: Open WebUI 0.11.0 before 0.11.4 Tool Source Disclosure via Tool Export Endpoint
desc: Open WebUI from 0.11.0 before 0.11.4 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows authenticated non-admin users with tool export permission to obtain tool source code shared with them read-only. Attackers can request GET /api/v1/tools/export to retrieve the full Python source of read-only shared tools, exposing embedded API keys and credentials.

title: Open WebUI 0.6.42 before 0.11.4 Memory Exhaustion via Compressed Remote Image
desc: Open WebUI from 0.6.42 before 0.11.4 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability that allows authenticated users to exhaust server memory by supplying compressed remote image URLs in chat messages. Attackers can point the image field at a host returning gzip-encoded responses, which get_image_base64_from_url decompresses unbounded, causing denial of service for all users.

title: Open WebUI 0.11.0 before 0.11.4 ReDoS via grep_knowledge_files Event Loop
desc: Open WebUI from 0.11.0 before 0.11.4 contains a regular expression denial of service vulnerability that allows authenticated users to stall server workers via file search patterns. Attackers can instruct the model to call grep_knowledge_files or grep_chat_files with a catastrophically backtracking regex, blocking the event loop for two seconds per repeated call.

title: Open WebUI 0.11.0 before 0.11.4 Memory Exhaustion via Knowledge Search Regex
desc: Open WebUI 0.11.0 before 0.11.4 compiles user-chosen grep patterns for its knowledge and chat file search tools with a regex engine that expands nested counted repetition unbounded at compile time and caches the result. Authenticated users can have the model call grep_knowledge_files with short nested-repetition patterns, blocking the event loop and exhausting worker memory.

title: Open WebUI 0.9.0 before 0.11.4 Denial of Service via Recurrence Rule Validation
desc: Open WebUI from 0.9.0 before 0.11.4 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows authenticated users with automations permission to stall the instance by submitting unsatisfiable recurrence rules. Attackers can repeatedly send rules like February 30th to the automations create or update endpoints, blocking the shared event loop for seconds per request.

title: Open WebUI 0.6.31 before 0.11.4 Stored XSS via Tool-Call Embeds
desc: Open WebUI from 0.6.31 before 0.11.4 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in its Markdown renderer, which treats user-authored tool-call details blocks as tool output and mounts their embeds attribute in script-enabled iframes. Authenticated users can post crafted channel messages, chat messages, or citation content that runs JavaScript in viewers' browsers, enabling in-app phishin

title: Parse Server before 8.6.93 and 9.0.0 before 9.10.1-alpha.13 protectedFields Bypass via Relation Count Query
desc: Parse Server before 8.6.93 and 9.0.0 before 9.10.1-alpha.13 does not enforce identity-scoped protectedFields (authenticated, role, or per-user groups) on count queries using the $relatedTo operator, exposing the size of protected Relation fields. An authenticated user who can read the owning object can combine counts with an objectId constraint as a membership oracle to reveal confidential members

title: Craft CMS 4.0.0 before 4.18.7 and 5.0.0 before 5.10.14 Arbitrary File Read via Twig create() DOMDocument
desc: Craft CMS 4.0.0 before 4.18.7 and 5.0.0 before 5.10.14 contains an arbitrary file read vulnerability because the Twig create() class blocklist does not cover DOMDocument. Attackers able to set an entry-type title format, including via project-config/apply, can use create('DOMDocument').loadHTMLFile() with textContent to expose local file contents to non-admin users who can view entries.

title: Craft CMS 5.10.2 before 5.10.14 Twig Sandbox Bypass RCE via has some/has every
desc: Craft CMS from 5.10.2 before 5.10.14 contains a Twig sandbox bypass that allows non-admin users to invoke PHP callables through the "has some" and "has every" operators. Users with the System Messages permission can supply two-argument callables such as passthru or system in sandboxed templates to execute code as the web user.

title: Craft CMS 4.0.0 before 4.18.7 and 5.0.0 before 5.10.14 RCE via actionCacheUpdates Behavior Injection
desc: Craft CMS 4.0.0 before 4.18.7 and 5.0.0 before 5.10.14 passes the raw 'updates' request parameter in AppController::actionCacheUpdates to UpdatesModel without Component::cleanseConfig(), allowing behavior and event-handler injection. Authenticated control panel users with the performUpdates permission or Updates-utility access can supply 'as' or 'on' keys, such as an AttributeTypecastBehavior gadg

title: SiYuan v3.7.0 before v3.8.6 Arbitrary File Read via Plugin ResponseFile.Path
desc: SiYuan v3.7.0 before v3.8.6 contains an absolute path traversal vulnerability in the kernel's private plugin HTTP server, which passes a kernel plugin handler's ResponseFile.Path to gin's Context.File without validation. Attackers supplying a malicious kernel plugin can return an absolute path to read any file readable by the SiYuan process, including the API token and conf.json.

title: SiYuan v3.1.12 before v3.8.6 Denial of Service via getDynamicIcon Template
desc: SiYuan v3.1.12 before v3.8.6 fails to restrict the Sprig template function map in the /api/icon/getDynamicIcon content parameter, allowing resource exhaustion. A publish reader, or anyone when publish auth is disabled, can use uncapped functions like until to OOM-kill the kernel with one request.

title: Grav Login Plugin 2.7.0 before 3.9.9 2FA Bypass via Remember-Me Cookie
desc: Grav Login plugin 2.7.0 before 3.9.9 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows attackers with a valid password to skip two-factor authentication through remember-me cookie restoration. Attackers can obtain a persistent remember-me cookie after the password step and restore it as a fully authorized session without completing the second factor.

title: Grav Login Plugin 1.2.0 before 3.9.9 Password Reset Token Disclosure via Reset Page
desc: Grav Login plugin 1.2.0 before 3.9.9 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows publishers to obtain password-reset tokens by authoring a page at the reset route. When a victim opens an emailed reset link, the publisher-controlled page rendered by Login::getPage() exposes the username and bearer token, enabling takeover of more privileged accounts.

title: Grav 2.0.22 before 2.1.7 Clockwork Debugger Token Disclosure via Twig Sandbox
desc: Grav from 2.0.22 before 2.1.7 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows page editors to read the Clockwork debugger token because the sandbox redaction list omits system.debugger.token. Attackers can render the token through editor-authored Twig and supply it as X-Clockwork-Auth to read profiler records with configuration, request metadata, and database queries.

title: Grav Git Sync 1.0.2 through 3.4.12 Command Injection via Commit Author
desc: Grav Git Sync 1.0.2 through 3.4.12 contains a command injection vulnerability that allows authenticated content editors to execute OS commands by injecting shell substitutions into profile fields. When the gravuser or gravfull author mode is enabled, attackers can set a malicious username, full name, or email that reaches PHP exec() via git commit --author, running commands as the web-server accou

title: Grav Guestbook Plugin 0.5.0 and 0.5.1 Missing Authorization and CSRF in Moderation
desc: Grav Guestbook plugin 0.5.0 and 0.5.1 contains missing authorization and cross-site request forgery vulnerabilities in Admin moderation actions delete, approve, and approveAll. Authenticated Admin users lacking the admin.guestbook permission, or external sites abusing a moderator's session via nonce-less GET requests, can delete or approve Guestbook entries.

title: Grav API Plugin before 1.0.36 Disabled Account Session Access Bypass
desc: The Grav API plugin (grav-plugin-api) before 1.0.36 contains an improper session validation vulnerability that allows disabled accounts to keep API access, because SessionAuthenticator does not enforce account state. Disabled users can reuse an already authorized browser or remember-me session to call API endpoints until expiry, defeating operator revocation.

title: Grav Star Ratings 2.0.1 through 2.0.3 Missing Server-Side vote_access Authorization
desc: Grav Star Ratings 2.0.1 through 2.0.3 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows unauthenticated visitors to vote by bypassing client-only vote_access and readonly enforcement. Attackers can use the anonymous nonce emitted by getData() to submit votes directly to addVote(), manipulating restricted or disabled ratings and aggregate rating output.

title: Grav before 2.1.7 Memory Exhaustion via Oversized Image Transforms
desc: Grav before 2.1.7 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows authenticated media authors to exhaust memory by uploading compressed oversized raster images. Attackers can reference a Twig or Markdown transform so GD or Imagick decodes the full source without dimension checks, letting anonymous requests repeatedly cause page unavailability.

title: Grav from 2.0.22 before 2.1.7 Clockwork Profiler Authentication Bypass via Proxy
desc: Grav from 2.0.22 before 2.1.7 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the Clockwork profiler that trusts loopback REMOTE_ADDR values. Unauthenticated attackers behind a same-host HTTP proxy can read profiler records exposing system and plugin configuration, secrets, request metadata, and queries.

title: Admidio 5.0.0 before 5.0.15 Unauthenticated Stored XSS via Registration Name
desc: Admidio 5.0.0 before 5.0.15 contains an unauthenticated stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in RegistrationPresenter.php, which inserts the raw FIRST_NAME registration value into an unencoded data-message attribute. Attackers can register with a double-quoted event handler that executes JavaScript in an administrator's session when they hover the entry on the Manage registrations page.

title: Admidio 4.3.2 through 4.3.17 and 5.0.0 before 5.0.15 Cross-Organization Access Control Bypass via members_assignment.php
desc: Admidio 4.3.2 through 4.3.17 and 5.0.0 before 5.0.15 contains a broken access control vulnerability that allows role administrators to assign users to roles in other organizations. Attackers can submit crafted assign requests to members_assignment.php with a foreign role UUID to gain privileged membership, log into that organization, and edit its user profiles.

title: Network-AI 5.0.0 before 5.15.2 Cross-Site WebSocket Hijacking via DashboardServer
desc: Network-AI 5.0.0 before 5.15.2 contains a cross-site WebSocket hijacking vulnerability in DashboardServer that allows remote attackers to read live agent topology because handleUpgrade performs no Origin or token validation. Attackers can lure a victim running the dashboard to a malicious page that opens a WebSocket to the loopback dashboard and exfiltrates agent IDs, roles, task descriptions, and

title: SurrealDB 3.0.0 before 3.3.0 Cross-Tenant Record Read via RETURN FETCH
desc: SurrealDB from 3.0.0 before 3.3.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated record users to read records in other namespaces or databases by resolving record ids through FETCH. Attackers can switch to a foreign namespace/database and name a known record id in a RETURN … FETCH query to read another tenant's data when table PERMISSIONS allow reads.

title: SurrealDB before 3.3.0 Cross-Tenant Access via Surreal-NS/Surreal-DB Headers and RPC use
desc: SurrealDB before 3.3.0 does not check the caller-selected namespace or database against the level at which a namespace- or database-level system user authenticated, allowing cross-tenant access. An authenticated attacker can set the Surreal-NS/Surreal-DB headers on /sql or call the RPC use method to read, create, modify, and delete rows and read DEFINE PARAM values in another tenant where table PE

title: SurrealDB 3.0.0 before 3.3.0 Information Disclosure via COMPUTED Fields
desc: SurrealDB from 3.0.0 before 3.3.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows record users to read values hidden by field-level SELECT permissions through COMPUTED fields. Attackers can select records whose readable COMPUTED fields derive from hidden fields, or use write RETURN clauses with $before/$after to expose hidden values.

title: SurrealDB before 3.3.0 Denial of Service via Headers Non-ASCII Values
desc: SurrealDB before 3.3.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows query-capable users to crash the server by reading non-ASCII header values in embedded JavaScript. Attackers with scripting enabled can read such values via Headers get(), entries(), values(), or getSetCookie(), or return them from fetch() endpoints, aborting the server process.

title: SurrealDB 3.1.0 before 3.3.0 Memory Exhaustion via Surrealism Module Output Buffering
desc: SurrealDB 3.1.0 before 3.3.0 lets Surrealism modules exhaust server memory because module stdout/stderr lines are buffered unbounded in host memory, bypassing the configured module memory limit. An attacker can run an Owner-installed malicious module that writes output without newlines, crashing the server and denying service to all namespaces and databases.

title: SurrealDB 3.1.0 before 3.3.0 Authorization Bypass via REFERENCE ON DELETE CASCADE
desc: SurrealDB from 3.1.0 before 3.3.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to delete protected graph edges by triggering a REFERENCE ON DELETE CASCADE. Attackers with delete permission on a referenced table can delete a record whose cascade disables permission checks for edge cleanup, erasing edges despite the edge table's PERMISSIONS FOR delete clause.

title: SurrealDB before 3.3.0 Cross-Tenant Access via USE Statement
desc: SurrealDB before 3.3.0 allows cross-tenant access because the SurrealQL USE statement switches a session to any namespace/database without checking that the caller's authenticated level covers it. Authenticated namespace, database, or record users can switch to another tenant and read, create, update, or delete rows in tables whose PERMISSIONS allow it, such as PERMISSIONS FULL.

title: DOMPurify from 3.4.13 before 3.4.16 DOM XSS via IN_PLACE afterSanitize Hooks
desc: DOMPurify from 3.4.13 before 3.4.16 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability because IN_PLACE mode fails to neutralize subtrees detached by afterSanitizeElements or afterSanitizeAttributes hooks. Attackers can supply markup with on* handlers inside a wrapper removed by such hooks, leaving handlers armed on the live DOM to execute script in the victim origin.

title: DOMPurify before 3.4.16 XSS via IN_PLACE Returned Rawtext Root
desc: DOMPurify before 3.4.16 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows attackers to bypass sanitization because IN_PLACE mode returns a force-removed style element whose text content still carries markup. Attackers can supply a style element containing a closing style tag and an img onerror payload, which executes script when the application serializes and re-parses the returned node.

title: Gitoxide gix-mailmap before 0.35.0 CPU Denial of Service via .mailmap Parsing
desc: Gitoxide gix-mailmap before 0.35.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows attackers to exhaust CPU through quadratic-time parsing in Snapshot::from_bytes. Attackers can commit a crafted .mailmap with descending-ordered entries forcing repeated front inserts, blocking workers running log, blame, or shortlog for minutes.

title: gix-pack before 0.75.0 Reachable Assertion DoS via Pack Version 3 Header
desc: gitoxide gix-pack before 0.75.0 contains a reachable assertion in BytesToEntriesIter::new_from_header: the pack header decoder accepts version 3, but a release-enabled assert_eq! requires version 2. A malicious remote can send a 12-byte pack header declaring version 3 to panic the client and abort the clone or fetch.

title: Gitoxide gix-pack before 0.75.0 Denial of Service via OFS_DELTA Base Distance
desc: Gitoxide gix-pack before 0.75.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows malicious remotes to crash fetch operations by sending crafted thin-pack OFS_DELTA entries. Attackers can serve a thin pack with a REF_DELTA referencing an existing object followed by an OFS_DELTA whose base_distance exceeds pack_offset, triggering a panic in LookupRefDeltaObjectsIter that aborts the fetch proce

title: LibreNMS before 26.9.0 SQL Injection via notification_id in notifications.inc.php
desc: LibreNMS before 26.9.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability that allows unprivileged users to inject SQL by supplying an array-valued notification_id parameter to notifications.inc.php. Attackers can perform cross-table reads of users.password hashes, with results persisted in notifications_attribs and readable through the interface.

title: LibreNMS before 26.9.0 Path Traversal via NFSen channel Parameter
desc: LibreNMS before 26.9.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability in nfsen_channel_common.inc.php that allows authenticated users to read unauthorized RRD data by injecting ../ sequences into the channel parameter. Attackers with access to one NFSen-enabled device can request graph.php with a traversed channel value to view traffic and NetFlow graphs of devices outside their authorized scope.

title: LibreNMS before 26.9.0 Stored XSS via Tools Oxidized Node List
desc: LibreNMS before 26.9.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in get_oxidized_nodes_list() that renders Oxidized API fields and SNMP sysName unescaped. Attackers controlling the Oxidized response or a device's SNMP sysName can inject script that executes in browsers of users viewing the Tools Oxidized page.

title: Edgeless Systems Contrast 1.8.0 before 1.24.1 World-Writable Containerd Config Privilege Escalation
desc: Edgeless Systems Contrast 1.8.0 before 1.24.1 contains an incorrect permissions vulnerability where the node installer writes the containerd config world-writable (0666). Local unprivileged users on the node can modify the containerd config, for example overwriting the runc location, to escalate privileges.

title: Contrast 1.8.0 before 1.24.1 Mesh CA Key Cross-Manifest Exposure via Peer Recovery
desc: Contrast 1.8.0 before 1.24.1 contains an improper verification vulnerability in Coordinator peer recovery that fails to confirm the serving peer uses the same manifest generation. Attackers with write access to manifest history can replay a superseded history head so withdrawn workloads obtain trusted mesh certificates, or with the secret seed disclose the Mesh CA key.

title: MONAI 0.4.0 before 1.6.1 RCE via SENet Pretrained Weights Over Plaintext HTTP
desc: MONAI 0.4.0 before 1.6.1 contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows on-path attackers to execute code by tampering with SENet pretrained weights fetched over plaintext HTTP. Attackers can substitute a crafted .pth file that load_state_dict_from_url unpickles without weights_only=True, executing code when SEResNet50 or other SENet models are constructed with pretrained=True.

title: Zebra 6.4.0 before 6.4.2 Denial of Service via Malformed v6 Transaction
desc: ZcashFoundation Zebra 6.4.0 before 6.4.2 parses version 6 transactions carrying a pre-NU6.3 consensus branch ID, but the size computation during UnminedTx construction treats re-serialization of the Orchard bundle as infallible, so the resulting error trips an expect that aborts zebrad. Unauthenticated peers can send a single pre-handshake tx message to crash the node, and can repeat this after ea

title: Zebra 2.3.0 before 6.4.0 Peer Ban Bypass via Exact-IP Keying
desc: Zebra 2.3.0 before 6.4.0 contains a protection mechanism failure that allows unauthenticated peers to evade bans because bans and misbehavior scores are keyed on exact IP addresses. Attackers can reconnect from fresh IPv6 addresses in their /64 allocation or flush the 20,000-entry FIFO ban list to restore access for banned peers.

title: Zebra before 6.4.0 Denial of Service via Same-Hash Forged Block Bodies
desc: Zebra before 6.4.0 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability that allows unauthenticated peers to force full proof verification by serving forged block bodies with valid header hashes. Attackers can flip authorizing-only bytes such as a coinbase scriptSig, wasting Sapling, Orchard, and Ironwood proof verification without penalty and stalling sync for 67 seconds.

title: ZITADEL 3.0.0 before 4.19.2 Account Takeover via SAML Identity-Provider Confusion
desc: ZITADEL 4.x before 4.19.2 and 3.x through 3.4.15 contains an authentication bypass in the SAML identity-provider intent callback, which verifies the assertion signature using the provider named in the request URL but resolves the user from the login intent without checking they match. Attackers with organization-administrator permission can register a SAML provider with their own signing key to ob

title: ZITADEL 3.0.0 before 4.19.2 Account Takeover via Unsigned Login V2 Session Cookie
desc: ZITADEL 3.0.0 before 4.19.2 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the Login V2 UI that allows unauthenticated attackers to obtain other users' session tokens by forging unsigned session cookies. Attackers can guess time-ordered session IDs around a victim's sign-in and supply them with empty tokens to receive rotated tokens, taking over accounts including MFA-completed administrator s

title: ZITADEL 3.0.0 before 4.19.2 Privilege Escalation via OIDC Token Exchange Impersonation
desc: ZITADEL 3.0.0 before 4.19.2 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability in OIDC token exchange that allows end-user impersonators to impersonate administrators including IAM_OWNER by bypassing the admin.impersonation check. Attackers holding IAM_END_USER_IMPERSONATOR or ORG_END_USER_IMPERSONATOR roles can sign in to relying applications as administrators with their roles and claims.

title: Vercel deepsec before 1.1.17 Arbitrary File Write via Symlink in Sandbox Tarball Extraction
desc: Vercel deepsec from 0.1.0 before 1.1.17 contains a link following vulnerability in extractTarballLocally that allows sandboxed code to write files outside the sandbox by planting links in result tarballs. Attackers controlling sandbox code, such as a prompt-injected coding agent, can plant symbolic or hard links in the host data directory to write arbitrary files on the orchestrator host.

title: SPIP before 4.4.18 SSRF via HTTP Redirects in recuperer_url
desc: SPIP before 4.4.18 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in recuperer_url() in ecrire/inc/distant.php that follows up to 10 redirects without re-validating targets with valider_url_distante(). Authenticated attackers can supply a remote URL, such as a syndicated site feed or remote document, that redirects to internal or link-local addresses including cloud metadata endpoints.

title: Cockpit CMS 2.14.1 Account Enumeration via Timing Discrepancy in /auth/check
desc: Cockpit CMS 2.14.1 contains an observable timing discrepancy vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to enumerate accounts due to an incomplete timing fix in /auth/check. Attackers can post login attempts and measure response times, since existing accounts incur two bcrypt operations versus one, revealing valid usernames and email addresses.

title: modern-tar 0.3.5 through 0.8.5 Memory Exhaustion via Malformed Octal Size Field
desc: modern-tar 0.3.5 through 0.8.5 contains a memory exhaustion vulnerability that allows attackers to produce negative entry sizes via non-octal bytes parsed by readOctal(). Attackers can supply a crafted, optionally gzip-compressed, archive to unpackTar() that buffers chunks indefinitely, exhausting process memory and suppressing later entries.

title: AnyDesk before 8.0.3 allows unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via a heap-based buffer overflow,
desc: AnyDesk before 8.0.3 allows unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via a heap-based buffer overflow, as demonstrated on Linux for command execution as root without the victim approving desktop control. In the stream packet handler for mode 5 in the session protocol, a payload length value is not validated.

title: Square Squash through commit e73f280 Unauthenticated YAML Deserialization via Symbolication API
desc: Square Squash through commit e73f280 contains an insecure deserialization vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to store crafted YAML via the POST /api/1.0/symbolication endpoint. title: Pimcore through 2026.3.1 Stored XSS via ExternalImage Field Version Preview
desc: Pimcore through 2026.3.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated backend users to inject scripts by storing unescaped URLs in ExternalImage fields. Attackers with data object edit permission can store attribute-breaking payloads that execute JavaScript in the admin origin when other users open version preview or diff views.

title: Thelia before 3.1.2 and 3.2.x before 3.2.1 CSV Formula Injection via Exports
desc: Thelia before 3.1.2 and 3.2.x before 3.2.1 contains a CSV formula injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated visitors to inject spreadsheet formulas by supplying crafted registration, checkout or newsletter fields. Attackers can submit names, addresses or phone values starting with =, +, - or @ that CSVSerializer exports verbatim, executing formulas in the administrator's spreadsheet appl

title: Thelia before 3.1.2 and 3.2.x before 3.2.1 File Upload RCE via Filename Trailing Space
desc: Thelia before 3.1.2 and 3.2.x before 3.2.1 contains an unrestricted file upload vulnerability that allows authenticated back-office users to upload PHP files by appending a trailing space to filenames. FileProcessorService validates the raw filename but FileManager::sanitizeFileName() strips the space, storing an executable .php file under public/cache/documents/ for code execution as the web serv

title: Gumlet php-image-resize before 3.0.1 Denial of Service via Decompression Bombs
desc: Gumlet php-image-resize before 3.0.1 contains a denial of service vulnerability because the ImageResize constructor in lib/ImageResize.php passes images to GD imagecreatefrom* functions without pixel limits. Remote attackers can upload small, highly compressed images that decode to large bitmaps, exhausting PHP memory and terminating the worker process.

title: NetEase Cloud Music Weak Encryption via eapi/xeapi
desc: NetEase Cloud Music client for Windows (cloudmusic.exe) versions 3.1.38 and 3.1.39.205426 contains a weak encryption vulnerability where /eapi/ and /xeapi/ API response bodies are decrypted using a fixed, publicly documented AES-128-ECB key with no integrity credential. Attackers who can intercept or originate server responses can construct valid ciphertext under the known key with PKCS#7 padding,

title: Tink-go 2.8.0 Keyset Validation Bypass via NewHandleWithNoSecrets
desc: Tink-go (tink-crypto/tink-go) through 2.8.0 contains an input-validation vulnerability where keyset.NewHandleWithNoSecrets() and ReadWithNoSecrets() skip the structural Validate() step before constructing a keyset.Handle, allowing malformed public or no-secret keysets that violate Tink's keyset invariants to be accepted. title: Telegram-Stremio 5.1.0 Insecure Session Storage via encode_string
desc: Telegram-Stremio through 5.1.0 contains an insecure storage vulnerability that allows attackers with access to the MongoDB database, backups, or logs to recover the operator's authenticated Telegram session string, which is protected only by a keyless, reversible encoding transform rather than actual encryption. Attackers can round-trip the stored value through the repository's own decode_string f

title: EdgeEver 1.6.0 through 1.112.0 Stored XSS via TemplatesPane Template Preview
desc: EdgeEver 1.6.0 through 1.112.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in TemplatesPane.tsx that renders template contentMarkdown with raw HTML via dangerouslySetInnerHTML without sanitization. Attackers can write templates containing HTML event handlers through an API or MCP token to run script on preview and access the privileged window.edgeeverDesktop bridge.

title: EdgeEver Desktop 1.6.26 through 1.112.0 Navigation Allowlist Bypass via will-navigate
desc: EdgeEver Desktop 1.6.26 through 1.112.0 contains a navigation allowlist bypass that lets attackers load arbitrary origins in the main window via string-prefix URL matching. Attackers can embed a link using userinfo syntax after the dev-server prefix, for example in a note-template preview, to obtain the edgeeverDesktop bridge including session token, sidecar RPC, and ACP channels.

title: Continue CLI through 1.5.47 Bash Permission Rule Bypass via Command Chaining
desc: Continue CLI (@continuedev/cli) through 1.5.47 contains a permission bypass vulnerability that allows attackers to run unapproved commands by chaining them after allowed Bash prefix rules. Attackers can inject instructions into repository files or fetched pages so the agent appends commands after ;, && or | to execute code as the user.

title: LearnHouse before 1.4.0 Missing Authorization via Playground Duplicate Endpoint
desc: LearnHouse before 1.4.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in POST /api/v1/playgrounds/{uuid}/duplicate that skips the read-access and draft checks enforced by get_playground. Authenticated users with playground creation rights, such as Instructors, who know a RESTRICTED or unpublished playground UUID can copy its html_content and republish it publicly.

title: Rapyd Admin 9.4.0 before 9.20.0 Stored XSS via select-list Component
desc: Rapyd Admin from 9.4.0 before 9.20.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject scripts through self-registered display names. Attackers can register with an HTML or JavaScript name rendered unescaped in the Activity log Author filter, executing in an administrator's session.

title: Shaark 1.2.13 through 1.2.44 Missing Authorization via API Update and Delete Routes
desc: Shaark 1.2.13 through 1.2.44 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the Link, Story, Chest and Album API controllers that skips ownership checks. Authenticated non-admin users can send PUT or DELETE requests to /api/{link,story,chest,album}/{id} with numeric IDs to overwrite or delete other users' content, including private items.

title: sandboxed.sh through 1.3.0 Container Escape via nsenter Missing Root Namespace
desc: sandboxed.sh through 1.3.0 contains a container escape vulnerability that allows code in container workspaces to access the host filesystem because nsenter attaches without --root. Agent-run code in a container workspace can resolve absolute paths on the host to read and modify host files, bypassing documented isolation.

title: Fire-Boltt BSW013 through V0.0.8 Unauthenticated BLE Notification Injection
desc: Fire-Boltt BSW013 smartwatch firmware through V0.0.8 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unpaired attackers to inject notifications by writing to the proprietary BLE command characteristic. Attackers within Bluetooth range can craft commands protected only by a CRC-16/ARC checksum to vibrate the watch and display spoofed alert text for phishing.

title: Open WebUI 0.8.6 before 0.11.4 Privilege Escalation via Terminal Proxy
desc: Open WebUI from 0.8.6 before 0.11.4 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability in the terminal proxy that allows authenticated users to reach the Terminals administrator API with the shared key attached. title: phpMyFAQ before 4.1.9 SQL Injection via api/autocomplete Search Endpoint
desc: phpMyFAQ before 4.1.9 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in PdoMysql::escape(), which escapes single quotes with backslashes that are treated literally when MySQL or MariaDB runs in NO_BACKSLASH_ESCAPES mode. desc: In HAProxy Data Plane API 2.2.0 through 3.4.3 (and corresponding Enterprise Edition releases), Server.ConfigureAPI() has process-global authentication logic that improperly drops security controls across multiple transport types. title: Hugo v0.60.0 before v0.167.0 Stored XSS via Table of Contents Heading IDs
desc: Hugo from v0.60.0 before v0.167.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows Markdown content authors to inject HTML by supplying crafted explicit heading IDs. Attackers can break out of the unescaped href attribute in .TableOfContents or .Fragments.ToHTML output to inject elements with event handlers into rendered pages.

title: Frappe before 16.33.0 Broken Authorization via send_sms Endpoint
desc: Frappe Framework before 15.120.0 and 16.x before 16.33.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the whitelisted send_sms API endpoint, which does not verify that the caller is permitted to send SMS messages. Users lacking the required permissions can invoke send_sms to send arbitrary SMS messages that impersonate the Company.

title: Frappe before v16.31.0 Stored XSS via Dashboard Chart Filters
desc: Frappe before 15.118.0 and 16.x before 16.31.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in dashboard chart filters because jQuery renders entered filter values as rich text. Authenticated attackers can store malicious filter values that execute scripts in the browsers of users who view the dashboard chart.

title: Frappe Framework before 16.17.0 Authenticated SSRF and LFI via pdfkit
desc: Frappe Framework 15.x before 15.107.3 and 16.x before 16.17.0 relies on a vulnerable pdfkit library (CVE-2025-26240) for PDF generation, enabling server-side request forgery and local file inclusion. Authenticated attackers can supply crafted content to PDF rendering to make the server fetch internal resources or embed local server files in generated PDFs.

title: Frappe ERPNext before 15.119.1 Missing Authorization Allows Unauthorized Document Modification
desc: Frappe ERPNext before 15.119.1 and 16.x before 16.32.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability because certain endpoints fail to enforce proper permission checks. Authenticated low-privileged users can call these endpoints to modify documents and data beyond what their assigned role permits.

title: Frappe ERPNext before 15.121.0 Missing Authorization in Certain Endpoints
desc: Frappe ERPNext before 15.121.0 and 16.x before 16.34.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in certain endpoints that fail to enforce proper authorization checks. Authenticated users can call these endpoints to modify data beyond what their assigned role permits.

title: Frappe ERPNext before 15.121.0 Missing Authorization in Document Creation Endpoints
desc: Frappe ERPNext before 15.121.0 and 16.x before 16.34.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in certain endpoints that fail to enforce proper permission checks during document creation. Authenticated low-privileged users can call these endpoints to create documents against records beyond their permitted role, bypassing role-based access controls.

title: Frappe ERPNext before 15.121.3 Missing Authorization Allows Unauthorized Data Modification
desc: Frappe ERPNext before 15.121.3 and 16.x before 16.35.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in which certain endpoints fail to enforce proper authorization checks. Authenticated users can send requests to these endpoints to modify data beyond what their assigned role permits.

title: Frappe ERPNext before 15.121.1 Unauthorized Document Modification via Missing Authorization
desc: Frappe ERPNext before 15.121.1 and 16.x before 16.34.2 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in certain endpoints that fail to enforce proper authorization checks. Authenticated attackers can send requests to these endpoints to modify documents and data beyond what their assigned role permits.

title: Frappe ERPNext before 15.120.0 Missing Authorization Exposes Personal Data
desc: Frappe ERPNext before 15.120.0 and 16.x before 16.33.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in certain endpoints that fail to enforce proper permission checks. Authenticated low-privileged users can request these endpoints to read personal data beyond what their assigned role permits.

title: Frappe ERPNext before 15.121.0 Unauthorized Status Modification via Missing Authorization
desc: Frappe ERPNext before 15.121.0 and 16.x before 16.34.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in certain endpoints that fail to enforce proper role checks when modifying record status. Authenticated low-privileged attackers can invoke these endpoints to alter data beyond their permitted role, compromising data integrity.

title: Frappe ERPNext before 15.121.3 Missing Authorization in Transactional Email Endpoint
desc: Frappe ERPNext before 15.121.3 and 16.x before 16.35.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an endpoint that sends transactional email through the site's configured outgoing account without checking the caller's authorization. Any authenticated user can supply arbitrary recipient lists and message content to send attacker-controlled messages carrying the organisation's sending identit

title: Frappe ERPNext before 15.119.1 Stored XSS via Public Booking Page
desc: Frappe ERPNext before 15.119.1 and 16.x before 16.32.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability because content submitted through a public-facing booking page is stored without neutralization. Unauthenticated attackers can submit crafted content that is rendered as raw HTML in a privileged user's session, executing script to act as that user and take over the account.

title: Frappe ERPNext before 15.121.0 SQL Injection via Unvalidated Endpoints
desc: Frappe ERPNext before 15.121.0 and 16.x before 16.34.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in some endpoints due to missing input validation. Authenticated attackers with high privileges can send specially crafted requests to these endpoints to inject SQL and extract sensitive information from the database.

title: Frappe ERPNext before 15.110.0 SQL Injection via Missing Input Validation
desc: Frappe ERPNext before 15.110.0 and 16.x before 16.21.0 contains a SQL injection vulnerability in some endpoints caused by missing input validation. Authenticated attackers can send specially crafted requests to these endpoints to manipulate database queries and extract sensitive information from the database.

title: Frappe ERPNext before 15.102.0 SQL Injection via Unvalidated Endpoint Requests
desc: Frappe ERPNext before 15.102.0 and 16.x before 16.8.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in some endpoints due to missing input validation, allowing manipulation of database queries. Authenticated attackers with low privileges can send specially crafted requests to the affected endpoints to extract sensitive information from the database.

title: Frappe ERPNext before 15.111.0 Missing Authorization Exposes Project Data
desc: Frappe ERPNext before 15.111.0 and 16.x before 16.22.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in certain project-related endpoints that fail to enforce permission checks. Authenticated low-privileged users can call these endpoints directly to read project data beyond what their assigned role permits.

title: Frappe ERPNext before 15.119.0 Unauthorized Access to Valuation Data
desc: Frappe ERPNext before 15.119.0 and 16.x before 16.31.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in certain endpoints that fail to enforce proper authorization checks on valuation data. Authenticated low-privileged users can query these endpoints to read valuation information beyond what their assigned role permits.

title: Frappe ERPNext before 15.106.0 SQL Injection via Missing Input Validation
desc: Frappe ERPNext before 15.106.0 and 16.x before 16.16.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in some endpoints due to missing input validation. Authenticated attackers can send specially crafted requests to inject SQL into database queries and extract sensitive information from the underlying database.

title: Frappe ERPNext before 15.102.0 SQL Injection via Unvalidated Endpoint Requests
desc: Frappe ERPNext before 15.102.0 and 16.x before 16.11.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in some endpoints due to missing input validation, allowing manipulation of database queries. Authenticated attackers can send specially crafted requests to the affected endpoints to extract sensitive information from the database.

title: Frappe ERPNext before 15.119.0 Stored XSS Leading to Account Takeover
desc: Frappe ERPNext before 15.119.0 and 16.x before 16.31.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability because record fields are rendered into an HTML attribute context without escaping. A low-privilege user can store a malicious payload in a record field that executes in the browser of any privileged user who opens the affected page, enabling account takeover.

title: Frappe ERPNext before 15.119.0 Missing Authorization in Transactional Email Endpoints
desc: Frappe ERPNext before 15.119.0 and 16.x before 16.31.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in which certain endpoints fail to verify that the caller may read a document before sending transactional email about it.
